summary: Located to the fringe of Penrith, in the Carleton Meadows development, a modern, semi-detached, 3 bedroomed (master ensuite), family home, with a green aspect to the front, providing flexible accommodation, found in excellent order throughout with parking, garage & private, fully enclosed garden.
description:
Built in 2017 and offered with the remainder of the 10-year NHBC guarantee, this appealing modern home presents an excellent opportunity to acquire a low-maintenance, energy-efficient family property, ideally positioned in this sought-after area with excellent access to Penrith town centre and the wider Eden Valley.

Occupying a particularly desirable plot, with attractive greenspace directly to the front, the property offers well-proportioned and flexible accommodation arranged over two floors. The ground floor comprises a welcoming entrance hall with useful downstairs WC, a comfortable lounge enjoying views over the front, and a spacious kitchen/dining room with French doors opening directly onto the rear garden. A separate utility room provides additional practical space.

To the first floor are three well-sized bedrooms, including a generous principal bedroom with its own ensuite shower room, together with a separate family bathroom.

Externally, the property benefits from a landscaped rear garden, designed for ease of maintenance and enjoying a good degree of privacy. Pedestrian access leads from the garden to the rear parking area, where there is also a garage.

An excellent choice for a growing family, this well-positioned modern home combines practical living accommodation with attractive outside space and convenient access to local amenities. Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the position, accommodation and setting on offer.

Directions From the town centre, follow Carleton Road until it meets the A686. Turn left and then take the 2nd left turning up the hill. Turn left into Primrose Drive and take the 1st left onto Tulip Gardens. Take the next left and at the end of this road turn left down the lane to reach the parking area to the rear of the house.

Services Mains gas, electric, water and drains are connected, but neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested.

Key Information: • Standard construction. • We understand that broadband and mobile telephone reception are available. For an indication of speeds and supply please see the OFCOM website: • There is private off road vehicle parking. • There is an annual development service charge of £143.07.
